# AdEasy

> AdEasy is a Winnipeg marketing partner for growing home service brands. We run their marketing department and the systems that support their growth: campaigns, vendors, websites, tracking and reporting, so owners know what's working and book more jobs. Founded in 2013 by Chris Karasewich.

AdEasy works with plumbing and drain, HVAC and mechanical, electrical, and window and door companies across Canada. Most partners are owner-led businesses that have outgrown doing marketing themselves. New partners start with a free Marketing Systems Assessment: we research the business, review eight marketing systems with the owner, and send a three-page report showing what's working, what needs attention and what to fix first.

Contact: 204-809-4978 · support@adeasy.com · 309 McDermot Ave, Unit 230, Winnipeg, MB R3A 1T3
